pages.text: Mathemagic does not consume mana. A material can instead serve as a $(thing)witness$(): proof that a local alteration has enough substance, precision, or stability to occur.$(br2)Witness materials are spent when the effect succeeds. Their properties depend on the world and its available materials, so packs may describe them differently.

pages.title: What Remains
pages.text: A $(thing)catalyst$() is not spent. It keeps a construction coherent, increases its available budget, or permits a more demanding relation.$(br2)The resource screen separates witnesses from catalysts. Hover a material there to read whether it is consumed or stabilizing the proof.
